note: A member DID in the request. The record listed is the signer's; a request naming someone else asks which rooms another member is in.

A state filter. Every surface lists the same record so that each shows the member the same rooms; a surface that wants fewer filters what it was given, rather than asking a question another surface does not ask.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
Credentials in an entry. They are collected with vtc/rooms/offers/list while an offer is open; a record listed long after it was accepted is not a second way to obtain them.
A withdrawn offer. Withdrawal is not a state a member was ever in; the community does not list it.
Room tags in an entry. Tags are administrators' filing, never shown to members.
